grouping_variable_identity: every A2 same-source-hypothesis unordered pair among all candidates generated by a SCAN: GROUP|h|min(wi,wj)|max(wi,wj), lexical pair rank independent of candidate-yield realization
per_witness_mapping: first non-CORRECT incident pair outcome in lexical pair-rank order; no incident pair => CORRECT; non-emitted witnesses retain no post-state but their A2 pair draws remain present
correct: attach first same-latent-event active hypothesis else create
over_merge: attach first different-latent-event active hypothesis else correct
confirm_suppression: resolve and suppress selected model hypothesis only; all other hypotheses remain active
